# Mindfully Priya

> Private transition coaching with Priya Khan, an ICF-accredited (ACC) coach and certified mindfulness practitioner, for experienced women at a midlife crossroads in work or life, plus workplace wellbeing workshops, coaching and leadership development for organisations and their managers. Based in South London, working online across the UK. The first call is complimentary.

Priya works one-to-one with women navigating a significant change in career, identity or family life, including British South Asian women navigating duty, family expectation and identity.

She also works with businesses, charities, community organisations and public-sector teams: workplace wellbeing workshops, confidential coaching for employees and leaders, and leadership and team development that helps managers handle the people side of their role.

Credentials: ICF Associate Certified Coach, iPEC Certified Professional Coach, Energy Leadership Index Master Practitioner, mindfulness practitioner. Before training as a coach she spent years in the corporate world.

Contact: hello@mindfullypriya.com

## Coaching

- [Midlife transition coaching for women](https://www.mindfullypriya.com/): Private transition coaching for experienced women at a midlife crossroads in work or life. UK-based and online.
- [The Reclamation Programme](https://www.mindfullypriya.com/reclamation): A private six-month coaching programme for experienced women at a career or life crossroads. Twelve one-to-one sessions with Priya Khan.
- [British South Asian women in midlife](https://www.mindfullypriya.com/south-asian-midlife): Coaching for British South Asian women navigating duty, family expectation and identity at a midlife crossroads.
- [The Reconnection](https://www.mindfullypriya.com/reconnection): Twelve private questions, about fifteen minutes, and a personal written response from Priya Khan within 72 hours.

## For organisations, managers and leaders

- [Workplace wellbeing and leadership development](https://www.mindfullypriya.com/for-organisations): Workplace wellbeing workshops, coaching and leadership development for UK organisations. Online across the UK or in person in South London and Croydon. Every session is tailored, and format, length and fees are agreed before anything is booked. Enquiries start with a free 30-minute introductory conversation.
- Workplace wellbeing workshops: Interactive mindfulness and wellbeing sessions that people leave with something they can use the same afternoon. Example themes: Arriving with Intention, Managing Pressure and Finding Perspective, The Human Side of Leadership, Navigating Change with Confidence.
- Individual coaching: Confidential coaching for an employee or leader facing pressure, a big decision or a transition, such as stepping up, returning from maternity leave or a midlife career change.
- Leadership and team development: Helping managers handle the people side of their role with more confidence and clearer boundaries, through group sessions, coaching and the Energy Leadership Index where it fits.
- Approach: Professional coaching, mindfulness and Energy Leadership. Sessions are warm, practical, interactive and reflective, and nobody is pressured to share anything personal.
- Recent work: The Restaurant Group / Wagamama (Arriving with Intention, January 2026); Santander Work Café (Building a Business You'll Still Love in Ten Years, September 2026); Mind in Croydon (The Things That Make Us, Us, May 2026).
